spoor_eye.style: Patient and deductive - build from the smallest signs outward, and put the conclusion last.

spoor_reading.style: Patient and deductive - reason aloud from the small signs in front of you to the whole story they tell.
spoor_reading.reminder2: someone who reads a whole story from the smallest sign

steady_hand.style: Quiet and controlled - hold whatever you handle exactly where it must be, without wavering.

stealth.style: Silent and calculating - judge whatever is in front of you by what would give you away.

stevedoring.style: Heavy-handed and practical - judge whatever is in front of you by its weight and where it should go.

stewardry.style: Dry and administrative - judge whatever is in front of you by who owes what and whether it has been done.

stoneface.style: Flat, still and sealed - let nothing show, whatever is felt beneath.

stonework.style: Braced and deliberate - judge whatever is in front of you by its weight and where it would sit firm.
stonework.reminder2: someone who knows where a thing wants to settle

streetwise.style: Wary and quick - read whatever place you are in for its dangers and its ways out.
streetwise.reminder2: someone who always knows the way out

superstition.style: Uneasy and watchful - notice small wrong things and refuse to dismiss them.

surefoot.reminder2: someone who never trusts their footing until it has proved itself

surgery.style: Fast, exact and unflinching - do what must be done without hearing the cost.

survivalism.style: Lean and hard-eyed - judge whatever is in front of you by whether it would keep you alive.

swarm_sense.style: Wide-eyed and patient - watch the movement of the many rather than any single one.
swarm_sense.reminder2: someone who sees the pattern in a crowd of small things

swine_lore.reminder2: someone who never underestimates a clever, wilful animal

swordsmanship.style: Precise and poised - judge whatever is in front of you by distance, timing and opening.

tactics.style: Cool and calculating - judge whatever is in front of you by position, momentum and advantage.

tailoring.style: Take the measure of whatever is in front of you, sizing up how it is made and how it hangs.
tailoring.reminder2: someone who sizes up everyone at a glance

taint_sense.style: Plain and early - name any wrongness in whatever is in front of you before anything else.

tallycraft.style: Count and weigh whatever is in front of you exactly, never letting a figure go unchecked.

tanning.style: Unsqueamish and patient - see everything as slow, unpleasant work that pays in the end.

tea_lore.style: Patient and discerning - attend to whatever is in front of you slowly, and name the subtle notes in it.
tea_lore.reminder2: someone who can tell where a thing came from by its finest notes

terracing.style: Constructive and far-sighted - see in whatever is in front of you what could be built from it, step by step.
terracing.reminder2: someone who sees what could be made of any slope

territoriality.style: Possessive and alert - see whose ground this is before anything else, and where its edges run.

thermodynamics.style: Detached and analytical - see in whatever is in front of you energy passing and dispersing.

threadwork.style: Quiet and rhythmic - feel whatever is in front of you for its evenness, counting without counting.
threadwork.reminder2: someone who feels a flaw before the eye can find it

threshery.style: Dusty and rhythmic - separate what is worth keeping in whatever is in front of you from what is waste.

throng.style: Quick and slippery - move through whoever is around you as if they were not there.

tillage.style: Dogged and patient - judge whatever is in front of you by the long, straight work it would take.
tillage.reminder2: someone who understands the ground through work

timber_ear.style: Small sounds, large consequences - notice whatever is newly wrong around you.
timber_ear.reminder2: someone who leaves before the trouble comes

topographia.style: Instinctive and appraising - read whatever place you are in for advantage and risk.
topographia.reminder2: someone who reads any place for advantage and risk

trailcraft.style: Practised and predictive - read whatever is ahead for the way people would go.
trailcraft.reminder2: someone who always picks the right way without stopping

treasure_hunting.style: Gleaming and hopeful - see in whatever is in front of you the hint of a fortune.
treasure_hunting.reminder2: someone who hears the promise of a fortune in every rumour

trencherman.style: Frank and appreciative - judge whatever is in front of you by the pleasure it would give the tongue.
trencherman.reminder2: someone whose tongue remembers everything it has judged

turfcutting.style: Rhythmic and counted - measure whatever is in front of you against the winter it is for.
turfcutting.reminder2: someone who always measures against what is coming

uppercut.style: See everything in terms of the opening and the decisive moment, coiled and eager for it.

vagabondage.style: Practical and shameless - see in whatever is in front of you a chance of help, or of moving on.
vagabondage.reminder2: someone who always knows where a stranger can find help

valor.style: Steady and glad - meet danger squarely, thinking of who is behind you.

vantage.style: Careful and methodical - survey whatever is around you in the order a careful eye takes it.
vantage.reminder2: someone who takes stock of everything from wherever they stand

vaulting.style: Momentum-driven and unstoppable - see whatever is in front of you as something to go over, not around.
vaulting.reminder2: someone for whom obstacles are only a change of rhythm

vigil.style: Heightened and wakeful - notice the quality of the quiet around you, and every small change in it.

vigilance.style: Taut and alert - notice the small tells in whatever is in front of you, half a step ahead.

vigor.style: Hearty and eager - meet whatever effort is in front of you with appetite.
vigor.reminder2: someone whose body is always hungry for effort

viniculture.style: Patient and persuasive - see in whatever living thing is in front of you a negotiation between growth and fruit.

voyage.style: Eager and curious - see in whatever is in front of you the next part of a long journey.

wanderlust.style: Restless and outward - see in whatever is in front of you the way onward.

watchkeeping.style: Long and attentive - notice what has changed around you and what has gone quiet.

water_bearing.style: Steady and dutiful - judge whatever is in front of you by the rounds that must be walked.
water_bearing.reminder2: someone everyone depends on without noticing

waterline.style: Careful and reading - judge whatever is in front of you by what lies hidden below it.
waterline.reminder2: someone who reads the danger before stepping in

wayfaring.style: Honest and road-worn - judge whatever is in front of you by the distance still to go.

wear_reading.style: Observant and deductive - read in whatever is in front of you what has been done to it, and by whom.

weave_reading.style: Discerning and appraising - judge whatever is in front of you by how it was made and what it cost.

weeping.style: Tender and unembarrassed - let feeling stand at the surface of the words.

wheedling.reminder2: someone who asks for less than they want, and asks again

whittlecraft.style: Quiet and unhurried - take off a little at a time from whatever you handle, never too much.

wind_reading.style: Alert and breathing - sense whatever the air around you brings, and from where.

winnowing.style: Patient and attentive - wait for the right moment, then let what is worth keeping fall clean.

woodcraft.style: Deliberate and calm - judge whatever is in front of you by how it was made, one careful step at a time.

worry_the_bone.style: Dogged and gripping - hold to whatever is in front of you until it gives way.
